atoms.exact_source_text: The unusual room, loft, earth, pool, or garden must join the Manor or its defended exterior circulation.
atoms.normalized_claim: Mouse-JOIN Guest House requirement: the unusual room, loft, earth, pool, or garden must join the Manor or its defended exterior circulation.

atoms.exact_source_text: The House must face, frame, or participate in communal ground while respecting the occupant's needed distance.
atoms.normalized_claim: Rabbit-GATHER Guest House requirement: the House must face, frame, or participate in communal ground while respecting the occupant's needed distance.

atoms.exact_source_text: The House must become a meaningful node with safe approaches, redundancy, and onward relation to the Web.
atoms.normalized_claim: Squirrel-CONNECT Guest House requirement: the House must become a meaningful node with safe approaches, redundancy, and onward relation to the Web.

atoms.exact_source_text: Height, water, warmth, darkness, airflow, concealment, flowers, dampness, open sightline, flight access, or other bodily need remains visible.
atoms.normalized_claim: Guest body requirement: bodily needs such as height, water, warmth, darkness, airflow, concealment, flowers, dampness, open sightline, flight access, or other bodily need must remain visible in the Guest House.

atoms.exact_source_text: The House is never a generic socket with an animal icon attached.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Guest House is never a generic socket with an animal icon attached.

atoms.exact_source_text: Placement cannot violate the Core civilization's spatial identity merely to satisfy the Guest.
atoms.normalized_claim: Guest House placement cannot violate the Core civilization's spatial identity merely to satisfy the Guest.

atoms.exact_source_text: Species accommodation may add real access, structure, food, warning, or environmental Load without increasing the Guest's Capacity above one.
atoms.normalized_claim: Species accommodation may add real access, structure, food, warning, or environmental Load without increasing the Guest's Capacity above one.

atoms.exact_source_text: The occupied House acquires a folk name connected to the resident or household.
atoms.normalized_claim: An occupied Guest House acquires a folk name connected to the resident or household.

atoms.exact_source_text: A vacant House persists unless deliberately adapted or dismantled.
atoms.normalized_claim: A vacant Guest House persists unless deliberately adapted or dismantled.

atoms.exact_source_text: Absence remains part of the Colony's geography.
atoms.normalized_claim: Absence of an occupant remains part of the Colony's geography.

atoms.exact_source_text: Recruitment begins with a named animal pursuing their own life.
atoms.normalized_claim: Recruitment begins with a named animal pursuing their own life.

atoms.exact_source_text: The player does not encounter a recruitable unit.
atoms.normalized_claim: The player does not encounter a recruitable unit during recruitment.

atoms.exact_source_text: Relationship precedes residence, and residence precedes Citizen integration.
atoms.normalized_claim: Relationship precedes residence, and residence precedes Citizen integration in the recruitment sequence.
